author: nickyeow

english.text: Everyone was listening very carefully.

jyutping: go3 go3 dou1 hou2 zyun1 sam1 gam2 teng1 gan2。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I hear you have been sick.
I hear you've been sick.
I hear that you've been sick.

jyutping: teng1 gong2 waa6 nei5 beng6 zo2 wo3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It's all over for me. I lost my job.

jyutping: ngo5 waan2 jyun4 laa3。ngo5 mou5 zo2 fan6 gung1 aa3。
text: 我玩完喇。我冇咗份工呀。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I take my clothes to the cleaner's twice a month.

jyutping: ngo5 mui5 bun3 go3 jyut6 zau6 wui5 lo2 ngo5 di1 saam1 heoi3 gon1 sai2 pou3 dou6 sai2。
text: 我每半個月就會攞我啲衫去乾洗舖度洗。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She's so cheap that she uses tea bags three times before she throws them away.

jyutping: keoi5 haan1 dou3 lin4 caa4 baau1 dou1 jiu3 jung6 saam1 ci3 sin1 se2 dak1 dam2。
text: 佢慳到連茶包都要用三次先捨得抌。

author: kaenif

english.text: Give me a coffee, please.

jyutping: m4 goi1 bei2 bui1 gaa3 fe1 ngo5 aa1。

author: cc_neko

english.text: How much did you pay for that?

jyutping: ni1 go3 nei5 bei2 zo2 gei2 do1 cin2。

author: cc_neko

english.text: I saw a red car and a white one. The red one was nicer looking than the white one.

jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 jat1 gaa3 hung4 ce1 tung4 jat1 gaa3 baak6 ce1。gaa3 hung4 ce1 hou2 tai2 gwo3 gaa3 baak6 ce1。
text: 我見到一架紅車同一架白車。架紅車好睇過架白車。

author: kaenif

english.text: This spoon is for soup.

jyutping: ne1 zi1 gang1 hai6 oi3 lai4 jam2 tong1 ge3。

author: fercheung

english.text: I don't know how I should do it.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 jiu3 dim2 zou6。

english.text: Happy birthday to you!

author: kaenif

english.text: He always has the first word.

jyutping: dai6 jat1 geoi3 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 keoi5 gong2。

author: kaenif

english.text: Oceans are expected to rise by 50 centimeters by the end of the next century.

jyutping: haa6 sai3 gei2 mut6 hoi2 min6 jyu6 gai3 wui5 sing1 ng5 sap6 lei4 mai5。
text: 下世紀末海面預計會升五十厘米。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It is no use going to school if you are not going to study.

jyutping: nei5 m4 duk6 syu1，faan1 hok6 dou1 mou5 jung6 gaa3。
text: 你唔讀書，返學都冇用㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We used to sing together all the time when we were children.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 coeng3 go1。
text: 我哋細個嗰陣成日一齊唱歌。

english.text: I demand to speak to your manager!

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I know Tom is irritated.

jyutping: ngo5 zi1 aa3 tong1 hou2 mung5 zaang1。

english.text: Many a gentleman of the old school has been provoked to remark regretfully upon the under-bred manners and bearing of even the better classes in the modern industrial communities; and the decay of the ceremonial code—or as it is otherwise called, the vulgarisation of life—among the industrial classes proper has become one of the chief enormities of latter-day civilisation in the eyes of all persons of delicate sensibilities.

jyutping: hou2 do1 gau6 paai3 ge3 sin1 saang1 dou1 bei6 gik1 nou6，deoi3 jin6 doi6 gung1 jip6 se5 keoi1 ge3 gaau3 hou2 gaai1 kap1 ge3 lai5 maau6 tung4 hang4 wai4 biu2 jin6 bat1 zuk1，gam2 dou3 wai4 ham6； ji4 hai2 so2 jau5 jau5 sai3 zi3 gam2 sing3 ge3 jan4 ngaan5 zung1，hai2 gung1 jip6 gaai1 kap1 jap6 min6，ji4 sik1 sau2 zak1 ge3 seoi1 lok6 —— waak6 ze2 zing3 jyu4 keoi5 so2 cing1 ge3，sang1 wut6 ge3 cou1 zuk6 faa3 —— ji5 ging1 sing4 wai4 zo2 gan6 doi6 man4 ming4 ge3 zyu2 jiu3 ok3 hang6 zi1 jat1。
text: 好多舊派嘅先生都被激怒，對現代工業社區嘅較好階級嘅禮貌同行為表現不足，感到遺憾； 而喺所有有細緻感性嘅人眼中，喺工業階級入面，儀式守則嘅衰落 —— 或者正如佢所稱嘅，生活嘅粗俗化 —— 已經成為咗近代文明嘅主要惡行之一。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Words such as "azul," "tanemmirt," and "aselmad" are modern Berber. They come from various Berber dialects and are not known in the Kabyle dialect. In fact, Kabyle uses words such as "ahla" for "hello," "ṣaḥḥa" for "thank you," and "ccix" for "teacher," and all these words are Arabic loanwords that are used and understood from Mauritania to the farthest reaches of Saudi Arabia. Denying the existence of the Berber language and modern Berber is completely useless and it is usually politically motivated.

jyutping: 「 azul 」、「 tanemmirt 」tung4「 aselmad 」ni1 di1 zi6 hai6 jin6 doi6 ge3 paak3 paak3 ji5 jan4，keoi5 dei6 lai4 zi6 m4 tung4 ge3 paak3 paak3 ji5 fong1 jin4，hai2 kaa1 bei2 ji5 fong1 jin4 jap6 min6 m4 sik1 jau4 mou4 lei5 taap3 nei4 aa3 dou3 saa1 dak6 aa3 laai1 baak3 zeoi3 jyun5 ge3 dei6 fong1，fau2 jing6 paak3 paak3 ji5 jyu5 jin4 tung4 jin6 doi6 paak3 paak3 ji5 jyu5 jin4 ge3 cyun4 zoi6 hai6 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 jung6 ge3，ji4 ce2 tung1 soeng4 hai6 jau5 zing3 zi6 dung6 gei1。si6 sat6 soeng6，kaa1 bei2 ji5 jung6「 ahla 」lai4 biu2 si6「nei5 hou2」、「 ṣaḥḥa 」lai4 biu2 si6「do1 ze6」、「 ccix 」lai4 biu2 si6「lou5 si1」ni1 di1 zi6，ji4 so2 jau5 ni1 di1 zi6 dou1 hai6 aa3 laai1 baak3 man4 ge3 ze3 ci4，jau4 mou4 lei5 taap3 nei4 aa3 dou3 saa1 dak6 aa3 laai1 baak3 zeoi3 jyun5 ge3 dei6 fong1 dou1 jung6 dou3 tung4 lei5 gaai2。
text: 「 azul 」、「 tanemmirt 」同「 aselmad 」呢啲字係現代嘅柏柏爾人，佢哋嚟自唔同嘅柏柏爾方言，喺卡比爾方言入面唔識 由毛里塔尼亞到沙特阿拉伯最遠嘅地方，否認柏柏爾語言同現代柏柏爾語言嘅存在係完全冇用嘅，而且通常係有政治動機。事實上，卡比爾用「 ahla 」嚟表示「你好」、「 ṣaḥḥa 」嚟表示「多謝」、「 ccix 」嚟表示「老師」呢啲字，而所有呢啲字都係阿拉伯文嘅借詞，由毛里塔尼亞到沙特阿拉伯最遠嘅地方都用到同理解。
